generation.prompt_exact: Edit the supplied plant sprite to correct the leaf structure. Keep its naturalistic detailed pixel-art style, lighting, overall rounded woody shrub form and transparent alpha background. Remove ALL the huge flat gray-green scalloped leaf shapes that currently form a solid backing screen across the top and sides. They are botanically wrong. Replace that entire solid backing with open transparent air containing thousands of fine delicate narrow threadlike branching gray-green leaves, each a few pixels wide, separated by visible little holes of empty alpha. Every foliage spray must be like wispy filiform Artemisia californica foliage: needle-thin split threads, much finer than rosemary, no flat fan leaves and no fern fronds. The outer perimeter must be made of sparse tiny twigs and extremely fine needle-thin foliage tips, with many tiny see-through gaps. Let woody stems show between delicate wispy sprays throughout the crown. A natural airy delicate lacework of extremely thin silver-green threads on branching brown stems. No large solid leaf silhouettes anywhere. Keep full plant including roots and every tip inside at least 8 percent empty alpha margin. Do not add text, UI, background, animals or cast shadow. Single complete transparent production pixel-art sprite.

tool_call_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE isolated California sagebrush shrub (Artemisia californica), complete production game sprite, on a genuinely transparent alpha background. High quality detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART, visibly crisp square pixel clusters and stepped contours, precise small pixel shading, not painted gradients or photographic cutout. Warm upper-left light, restrained gray green silvery foliage and thin brown woody stems. Three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility; no text, UI, animals, backdrop, frame, checkerboard.

Botanical accuracy is essential: California sagebrush has exclusively VERY FINE, THREADLIKE, DEEPLY DIVIDED FILIFORM LEAF SEGMENTS on delicate arching stems. Every leaf is tiny and feathery, like soft narrow green threads and little branching sprays. An AIRY NATURAL WOODY MOUND, small rounded shrub with see-through negative spaces, multiple thin branching brown stems visible through fine foliage from base to outer crown. NO BROAD LEAVES ANYWHERE. NO GIANT FLAT LEAF SHAPES behind foliage. NO scalloped broadleaf background silhouette. Not sage broad leaves, not fern fronds, not a cedar tree. Healthy winter/spring gray-green fine foliage; no showy flowers. Root collar and only a few tiny contact pebbles.

Plant centrally, at most 72 percent width and 72 percent height, with at least 12 percent transparent margins on all sides. All delicate twig tips entirely in frame. No ground rectangle or large shadow. One flattened whole sprite, not independently layered branches and foliage. Calm refined botanical detail with clearly readable fine divided leaves.
